name: Jocko Fuel
description: US sports nutrition and functional beverage brand co-founded by retired Navy SEAL Jocko Willink, selling protein (Mölk), energy drinks, greens, hydration and supplements with transparent, filler-free labeling, DTC and in 75,000+ retail doors.

evidence.summary: FMTC's featured-merchant profile states the Jocko Fuel Affiliate Program is powered by Commission Junction (CJ Affiliate): affiliates earn 15% commission for new customers and 10% for returning customers, with 30-day cookies and regular promotions. No earnings cap is stated, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

Jocko Fuel's own storefront confirms the product range (energy drinks, protein powder, greens, hydration, protein shakes) and national retail distribution in 75,000+ stores, with a 4.7 average across 30,000+ reviews.

reasons.niche_fit: Performance nutrition and clean-label supplements are a core wellness-creator niche, with strong military/fitness audience overlap.
reasons.ugc_evidence: An established CJ network program with published rates, promoted to content publishers; the brand is heavily creator- and podcast-driven.
reasons.compensation: 15% on new customers and 10% on returning customers via CJ, published by FMTC's merchant profile.
reasons.contact_access: No public program email found; application runs through CJ/FMTC, so access is network-mediated.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open network program on CJ with 30-day cookies and regular promotions.
reasons.credibility: Major national brand in 75,000+ retail doors, founded by a well-known public figure, formal network tracking and payment.

name: Bucked Up
description: Utah-based sports nutrition brand (DAS Labs LLC) known for Bucked Up pre-workout, protein, creatine and energy drinks, sold DTC and through major supplement retailers, with a large ambassador community.

evidence.summary: Bucked Up's own Brand Ambassador Agreement (2025 Edition) sets the commission structure: 1 Star Ambassadors earn 10%, 2 Star 15%, 3-5 Star 20% on completed orders via promo codes/links (no commission on energy drinks, protein soda or the one-time 50% code). Earnings over $25/month are paid via PayPal; under $25 paid as store credit. No earnings cap is stated, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

The agreement is a structured creator program: application reviewed in 3-5 business days, FTC disclosure rules, and a content-usage license for tagged ambassador content (UGC) across the brand's platforms. Note: the agreement includes an exclusivity clause barring ambassadors from promoting competing supplement brands.

reasons.niche_fit: Pre-workout and sports nutrition are core fitness-creator territory and the brand is built around ambassador content.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A formal ambassador agreement with tracked codes/links and a UGC licensing clause for tagged content.
reasons.compensation: 10% base (1 Star) rising to 20% at 3-5 Star, published in the brand's own agreement; PayPal payment above $25/month.
reasons.contact_access: Full published agreement and application route on the brand's own site; no public program email found.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application with 3-5 day review, but the exclusivity clause (no competing supplement promotion) limits creator flexibility.
reasons.credibility: Established national supplement brand (DAS Labs) with a formal, detailed legal agreement.

name: Free Soul
description: UK women's wellness brand making nutritionist-formulated supplements, vegan protein blends, greens, electrolytes and collagen/creatine products designed specifically for women's health needs.

evidence.summary: Free Soul's own affiliate registration page (UpPromote) publishes the commission structure: 1-4 referrals paid at 8%, 4-9 referrals at 10%, 10+ referrals at 12%, calculated on order value excluding tax/shipping. No earnings cap is stated, so the cap is recorded as unknown. The brand also runs an Awin programme (8% for content publishers).
The registration terms publish the program contact email nicole@herfreesoul.com for affiliate support and removal requests.

reasons.niche_fit: Women's wellness is a high-demand creator niche and every product is formulated and marketed for women.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A formal affiliate program with published tiered terms on the brand's own registration page, plus a parallel Awin programme.
reasons.compensation: 8% base commission rising to 12% at 10+ referrals, published in the brand's own program terms.
reasons.contact_access: Published program email (nicole@herfreesoul.com) plus a self-serve registration page - top band.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open registration (brand may approve or reject at its discretion).
reasons.credibility: Established UK DTC wellness brand with nutritionist-formulated products and formal program terms.

name: Pop Daddy Snacks
description: Michigan-based snack brand (founded 2013, Howell, MI) selling bold-flavored pretzels, drizzled popcorn, kettle chips and cheese puffs DTC and through Walmart, Target, Kroger and other national retail; famous for its TikTok Shop affiliate flywheel.

evidence.summary: Systemaic's teardown documents Pop Daddy's growth model as creator-led and built around a TikTok Shop affiliate flywheel: co-owner JT Sarafa quantified affiliates generating 1,000+ posts, 7M views and more than 50% of total sales in a 30-day window, with self-reported ~$6M/yr TikTok Shop GMV.

A TikTok Shop product marketplace listing shows Pop Daddy's 14-flavor pretzel variety pack carrying a 15% public affiliate rate with 77,207 reported sales. TikTok Shop rates are set per product, so the program-level commission_rate is recorded as null with this listing rate documented here.

opportunity.title: Pop Daddy Snacks TikTok Shop Affiliate Program

reasons.niche_fit: Snack taste-test and ranking content is a proven food-creator format and this brand was built on it.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Affiliates drive over half of sales with 1,000+ creator posts in 30 days - an exceptionally strong, documented UGC engine.
reasons.compensation: Rates are per-product on TikTok Shop; the hero variety-pack listing publicly shows 15%, but no single program rate is published.
reasons.contact_access: No public creator-program email found; entry is through TikTok Shop's affiliate marketplace.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open TikTok Shop affiliate listings with very high reported unit sales.
reasons.credibility: Bootstrapped brand founded 2013 with national retail distribution and a publicly documented growth record.

name: Drizzilicious
description: US snack brand selling drizzled mini rice cakes and drizzled popcorn (90 calories per serving, certified gluten-free, vegan, allergen-free) DTC and at Costco, Publix and other retailers; scaled to $5M+ TikTok Shop GMV through a mass micro-creator affiliate network.

evidence.summary: A TikTok Shop product marketplace lists Drizzilicious products with public affiliate rates of 10% (12-pack mini rice cakes variety pack, 114,472 reported sales) and 7.5% (6-pack 4oz variety, 80,553 reported sales). Rates are per-product on TikTok Shop, so the program-level rate is recorded as null.

Multiple creator-economy case studies report Drizzilicious recruited roughly 80,000 creators into its TikTok Shop affiliate network, generating $5M+ GMV and 60M+ views in six months - an absolute creator count in the tens of thousands, so creator saturation is recorded as high.

reasons.niche_fit: Snack haul, taste-test and flavor-ranking content is a core food-creator format and the brand's entire model.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A documented mass micro-creator affiliate network on TikTok Shop with $5M+ GMV attributed to creator content.
reasons.compensation: Per-product TikTok Shop rates publicly listed at 7.5-10% on hero SKUs; no single program rate published.
reasons.contact_access: Published support email (support@drizzilicious.com) on the brand's own site; affiliate entry via TikTok Shop.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open TikTok Shop affiliate listings with six-figure reported unit sales.
reasons.credibility: Certified gluten-free/vegan brand with Costco and Publix distribution and a documented sales record.

name: Ekkovision
description: US sports nutrition brand selling third-party-tested protein, creatine and pre-workout, famous on TikTok Shop (3.2M+ units sold across its shop) with a two-track affiliate system feeding an athlete roster.

evidence.summary: Ekkovision's own FAQ (Partnerships section) confirms two affiliate systems - a Website Affiliate Program and a TikTok Shop Affiliate Program. Anyone can apply; approved affiliates earn commission via a personal discount code, and top performers (~$7,500+/month in sales) are promoted to Athlete status. No commission rate or earnings cap is published on the page, so both are recorded as unknown/null.

Ekkovision's official TikTok Shop shows 3.2M units sold across products and 367K+ followers, with creator-commission videos attached to its listings - scale evidence for the TikTok Shop route, though no absolute creator count is published, so saturation stays unknown.

reasons.niche_fit: Third-party-tested protein and creatine are staple fitness-creator products and the brand is native to TikTok Shop.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand's own FAQ documents an open affiliate program on two tracks plus a performance-based athlete tier.
reasons.compensation: Commission exists on both tracks but no rate is published in the fetched sources, so the rate is honestly null.
reasons.contact_access: Published support email (Support@ekkovsn.com) and a documented application route in the brand FAQ.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Anyone can apply per the brand's FAQ; approval required before earning.
reasons.credibility: Large, verifiable TikTok Shop sales volume (3.2M units) and third-party-tested product positioning.

name: Clean Nutra
description: US supplement brand (Clean Nutraceuticals) selling multi-ingredient formulas - sea moss, berberine, black seed oil, multimineral and blood-sugar support drops - made in the USA under GMP, and one of TikTok Shop's biggest supplement sellers (2.0M+ units sold).

evidence.summary: Clean Nutra's official TikTok Shop shows 2.0M units sold and 129.7K+ followers, with 'Creator earns commission' affiliate videos attached to its product listings, confirming an active TikTok Shop affiliate program. TikTok Shop rates are per-product and not published in the fetched listing, so the rate is recorded as null.
Clean Nutraceuticals' own storefront confirms the product line (MultiMineral, Gluco Gone/GlucoTone and liquid drops), US GMP manufacturing and independent lab testing claims.

The brand's own social content features TikTok affiliates describing ongoing Clean Nutra partnerships (samples, outreach, monthly commissions), corroborating a structured, actively managed affiliate program rather than a passive listing.

opportunity.title: Clean Nutra TikTok Shop Affiliate Program

reasons.niche_fit: Multi-ingredient wellness formulas (sea moss, berberine) are among the most promoted supplement categories on TikTok.
reasons.ugc_evidence: 2.0M units sold on TikTok Shop with commission-earning creator videos and brand-produced affiliate success content.
reasons.compensation: TikTok Shop per-product rates are not published in fetched sources, so the rate is honestly null.
reasons.contact_access: No public program email found; entry is through TikTok Shop and brand outreach.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open TikTok Shop affiliate listings at very large sales volume.
reasons.credibility: Very large verifiable sales volume, but a young DTC brand with aggressive affiliate marketing - mid credibility.

name: WeightWorld
description: UK wellness retailer established in 2005 selling weight-management, collagen, superfood, vitamin and joint-health supplements and devices across the UK and Europe under its own brand.

evidence.summary: WeightWorld's Awin programme profile states a flat 10% commission on each qualified sale (5% for voucher/cashback sites), a 30-day cookie, and a dedicated affiliate manager reachable at affiliates@comfortclick.co.uk. No earnings cap is stated, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

reasons.niche_fit: Broad wellness catalogue (collagen, superfoods, vitamins) fits general wellness creators, though it is a retailer-style range.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A formal Awin programme with banners, feeds and a named affiliate manager; less creator-native than TikTok-first brands.
reasons.compensation: Flat 10% on qualified sales published in the Awin programme profile.
reasons.contact_access: Published affiliate-manager email (affiliates@comfortclick.co.uk) plus the Awin profile - strong access.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open Awin programme across UK and European markets.
reasons.credibility: Trading since 2005 with multi-country European operations and a formal network programme.

name: Gainful
description: US personalized performance-nutrition brand: quiz-based custom protein blends plus pre-workout, hydration, greens and collagen, built around unflavored protein with mix-in flavor packets; 300,000+ customers.

evidence.summary: LinkClicky documents Gainful's affiliate program on Rakuten Advertising at 6%-10% per sale. Other fetched listings conflict - Lasso lists $30 per sale and Shopper lists 5-10% - so commission_rate is recorded as null with the conflict documented here. A separate Trainerize x Gainful trainer channel pays 20% first order / 10% recurring but is restricted to fitness professionals. No earnings cap is stated anywhere, so the cap is unknown.
Gainful's own site confirms the personalized protein model, 7 goal-based blends and 300,000+ customers.

reasons.niche_fit: Personalized protein is a distinctive, content-friendly angle for fitness and wellness creators.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A documented Rakuten network program plus a trainer partnership channel; moderate creator-native evidence.
reasons.compensation: Published figures conflict (6-10% vs $30 flat vs 5-10%), so no single rate can be honestly recorded.
reasons.contact_access: No public program email found; application via Rakuten Advertising.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open network program; the higher-paying trainer channel is professionals-only.
reasons.credibility: Established DTC brand with 300,000+ customers and a formal network presence.

name: Wellue
description: Consumer health-device brand (by Viatom) selling home pulse oximeters, ECG monitors, blood-pressure monitors and sleep trackers direct to consumers through its own store.

evidence.summary: Wellue's own affiliate page (program run on GoAffPro) states affiliate members earn 2%-12% commission depending on product value and exposure volume, with a 30-day tracking window, a 10% customer discount code per affiliate, and PayPal payment after manual application review. Because only a range is published, the base figure of 2 is recorded with the range documented here. No earnings cap is stated, so the cap is unknown.

reasons.niche_fit: Home health monitoring is a real but narrower creator niche than supplements or snacks.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A formal affiliate page explicitly seeking review and content partners, run on GoAffPro.
reasons.compensation: Published range of 2%-12% depending on product and volume; only the 2% floor is certain.
reasons.contact_access: Application form on the brand's own affiliate page; no public program email found.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application with manual review for brand alignment.
reasons.credibility: Established device brand storefront, but a China-based parent and modest program transparency.
